actions.desc: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.
actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.
actions.name: Claw

actions.desc: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest):
actions.name: Roar

actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute.
actions.name: First Roar

actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
actions.name: Second Roar

agent_clauses: and the target has the Prone condition
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
actions.name: Third Roar

actions.desc: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
actions.name: Spellcasting

legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.
legendary_actions.name: Arcane Prowl

legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
legendary_actions.name: Weight of Years

traits.desc: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.
traits.name: Inscrutable

traits.desc: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
traits.name: Legendary Resistance
